# Syzygy test fixture

`KQvK.rtbw` and `KQvK.rtbz` are the tiny regular-chess fixtures from the upstream
[`python-chess` test data](https://github.com/niklasf/python-chess/tree/master/data/syzygy/regular).
They are used only to verify real WDL/DTZ probing and are covered by python-chess' GPL-3.0 license.

- `KQvK.rtbw`: `45c453e5113a714bd4ece1cb5ba78cf5d21dd8b06f89708675d164fbe9bd3b53`
- `KQvK.rtbz`: `ad20819e947f38bf06865a888dbde488ee4a34d2aa64b5727e1882313b1273a3`
